## Top Keywords on Etsy Now

# Top Keywords on Etsy Now

3 June 2026

•

11 min read

[![](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/facebook.png)](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://help.erank.com/blog/top-keywords-on-etsy/)

[![](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/linkedin.png)](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https://help.erank.com/blog/top-keywords-on-etsy/)

[![](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/reddit.png)](https://reddit.com/submit?url=https://help.erank.com/blog/top-keywords-on-etsy/)

![eRank monthly trend report for Etsy US, May 2026, top searches including tshirt, stickers, and fathers day gift](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/top-etsy-us-search-terms-may-2026.webp)

Yep, we’re back with the top keywords on Etsy now. So let eRank take the guesswork out of your Etsy SEO and product research. First, we’ll show you which of the Top 20 most popular search terms are hottest with US shoppers. Then we’ll analyze which of the month’s Top 200 searches are Etsy top sellers these days.

> Tip: See what the [_most searched keywords on Etsy_](https://erank.com/trend-buzz/etsy/us/daily) were yesterday, as well as on dozens of other marketplaces like [_Amazon_](https://erank.com/trend-buzz/amazon/us/daily), [_eBay_](https://erank.com/trend-buzz/ebay/us/daily), and [_Google Shopping_](https://erank.com/trend-buzz/googleshopping/us/daily).

## May’s Top 20 Etsy US searches

01. tshirt
02. shirt
03. stickers
04. wall art
05. fathers day gift
06. ring
07. pokemon
08. halloween
09. womens clothing
10. png
11. digital products
12. press on nails
13. keychain
14. rings
15. crochet
16. earrings
17. graduation
18. phone case
19. mothers day
20. poster

_Warning: Beware of trademarked terms. This report may contain keywords that are trademarked.  [USPTO Trademark Database](https://www.uspto.gov/trademarks-application-process/search-trademark-database)_

May is a month with an uncommon amount of turnover every year. It has an upcoming change of season, and Mother’s Day gift shopping segueing to “Dads and Grads.” So this Top 20 is as expected. Except, that is, the one that made us data geeks do a double take, “What the– ?!”

#### Ranked 8th: “halloween,” up from \#40

![Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “halloween.” On the right, the line chart depicts its search-volume history over the past 15 months. Notably, "halloween" has both gold badges. "High Conversion!" indicates 30+ days of lots of shoppers adding to cart and purchasing. And "Trending in Search!" tells us "halloween" is also among the top searches on Etsy this week.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-1.png)Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “halloween.” On the right, the line chart depicts its search-volume history over the past 15 months. Notably, “halloween” has both gold badges. “High Conversion!” indicates 30+ days of lots of shoppers adding to cart and purchasing. And “Trending in Search!” tells us “halloween” is also among the top searches on Etsy this week.

This time last year, “halloween” ranked #272, which is typical for May. Normally, as you can see above right, searches don’t start really climbing until July. And that July start is much earlier than on other ecommerce sites. It starts in July because Halloween is HUGE on Etsy; many fans shop year round. Just never this many this soon!

So, buckle up! Last year in May, there was just that one search, #272 “halloween,” in the Top 1000. This year, there are _six_, and five are in the Top 500.

#8 halloween

#255 halloween shirt

#354 halloween embroidery pattern bundle

#441 halloween decor

#449 halloween sweatshirt

#581 halloween png

Of course, no ordinary mortal can rank for the broad keyword “halloween.” The rest of these searches give you an idea of what early shoppers are after. Use them as leads to start _niching down_. For anyone who is new, here is a quick tutorial.

### Demo: How to use Keyword Tool to niche down

You “niche down” from a broad, highly-competitive keyword to one you can be found for in Etsy search. Best practice is to do this research before choosing a product to sell. Let’s assume you want to sell PNGs. You know Halloween is super popular with Etsy shoppers. You enter “halloween png” in Keyword Tool and see there is considerable competition. So from there, scroll down the page to its related searches table.

Here we’ve chosen to filter results to those that have our exact term, “halloween png.” Next, for sort order, we clicked the “Search Trend” column header. This shows us which keywords are trending highest now. And look at that: Etsy Competition (farthest right column) drops dramatically! From nearly half a million Etsy US listings using “halloween png,” to under 30,000 for “disney halloween png.” And from there, competition is in the green, some even too low to accurately estimate!

![Related keywords table for "halloween png" showing shopper searches and their data re: search history, clicks, CTRs, rank difficulty, and competition.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-4.png)Related keywords table for “halloween png” showing shopper searches and their data regarding search history, clicks, CTRs, rank difficulty, and competition.

We see a couple promising leads, circled here in purple. While its Average Searches stat is low, in May “breast cancer halloween png” got 1,000+ searches. Even better, it has a healthy Average CTR of 89%, and fewer than 7,000 listings are using it. The other, “mandala design halloween png” only had about 500 searches in May. But nevertheless, it is worth watching. Because 148% CTR is an absolute ton of purchase intent!

### Tip! Click-through rates and purchase intent

For those of you who are new to selling online, this will be a useful tip. Here’s a quick explainer.

> On ecommerce sites, click-through rates (CTRs) reflect how many times shoppers clicked listings in their search results. Therefore, CTRs are an indicator of ‘purchase intent.’ These are people more likely searching with the intention to buy, as opposed to those just browsing.

You’ll want to keep up with the top keywords on Etsy now, yes. But for insight into which are _selling_ best, look to their click-through rates. It’s why we end all these trend reports with a Monthly CTR Roundup. You’ll find out which of the current Top 200 keywords have had the highest CTRs most recently.

First though, let’s see which of this month’s highest ranked keywords climbed the quickest in May.

### Top Etsy searches climbing highest fastest now

We have nine keywords in this Top 20 that weren’t in the previous Top 20. The fastest and highest climber of the nine is this one.

#### Ranked 5th: “fathers day gift,” up from \#210

![Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “fathers day gift.” The line chart depicts its 15-mo search history. And it has eRank's "Trending in Search!" badge to indicate it is still one of the top keywords on Etsy now.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-2.png)Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “fathers day gift.” The line chart depicts its 15-mo search history. And it has eRank’s “Trending in Search!” badge to indicate it is still one of the top keywords on Etsy now.

“Fathers day gift” is up 38% over last year in May. Go dads! Here are the other eight; none of these had far to climb. They were all in last month’s Top 50.

Ranking 6th: “ring,” up from #46

8th: “halloween,” up from #40

10th: “png,” up from #21

11th: “digital products,” up from #23

12th: “press on nails,” up from #31

14th: “rings,” up from #24

15th: “crochet,” up from #26

17th: “graduation,” up from #22

Apart from “halloween” and the two seasonal Dads & Grads searches, the rest are Top 20 frequent flyers. Which is to say, they are popular products year round with Etsy shoppers. Expect seller competition to reflect that. On the other hand, they’re all broad keywords and should be easy enough to niche down. And now you all know how to do that; just follow the steps in our demo above. So next, let’s move on to which top Etsy searches show the most purchase intent.

Analyzing monthly CTRs is how we spot opportunities for you. Products we get most excited about are in the Top 200 and have:

- 125%+ CTRs for the current month
- 100%+ Average CTRs
- 1,000+/mo searches in five+ of the past 15 months
- Low competition (green in Keyword Tool)

We call these “unicorns” (because everyone on Etsy claims they don’t exist). And yet in every Roundup, we do seem to find a few. Fingers crossed!

## Monthly CTR Roundup!

Here for ideas of what to sell on Etsy? Then this is for you! Your insider access to which of the 200 top keywords on Etsy now have 125%+ monthly CTRs. Keep in mind, these calculations are drawn exclusively from our most recent full month of data. Which means that whatever their 12-mo CTRs, most of these products are what’s selling best now. Any related to Mother’s or Father’s Day, graduation or teacher gifts, add to a [Keyword List](https://help.erank.com/features/keyword-lists/) for next year.

### Ranking \#1-50

In the Top 20, there are three that qualify for this month’s Roundup: **stickers**, **pokemon** and **poster**. Wow, poster’s monthly CTR is way up, from 122% a month ago to 149%! That’s about as high as they go. So let’s go see what we can see, shall we?

#### \#20 “poster” – May CTR: 149%

![Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “poster.” The line chart depicts its search-volume history over the past 15 months.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-3.png)Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “poster.” The line chart depicts its search-volume history over the past 15 months.

See that? “Poster” has both gold badges. Remember, “High Conversion” indicates 30+ days with high numbers of shoppers purchasing or adding to carts. And “poster” continues to be among the top searches on Etsy this week. Viewing on a small screen? “Poster” also has quite an exceptional 12-mo CTR too: 135%!

Moving on to the rest of this month’s Top 50, surprisingly there is just one more qualifier. But it’s a dandy: #47 **dad** **shirt** has a perfect 150% for May.

### Ranked from \#51-100

There’s a pair at #53-54: **ayn thor** and **lanyard**; “lanyard” has 150%. Skip one and there’s **plants**, followed by #68 **bracelet** and #71 **fathers day shirt**. At #76 we have **nails**, then #81 **witch hat atelier** and #83 **wood**.

#### \#83 “wood” – May CTR: 150%

![Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “wood.” The line chart depicts its 15-mo search history.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-6.png)Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “wood.” The line chart depicts its 15-mo search history.

Looking for ideas of what to sell on Etsy? According to our sources, wood is continuing to trend this year, especially in decor. Check out wood’s related searches table, filtered and sorted as shown in our demo above. We see some interesting leads there.

Meanwhile, winding up the Top 100, three high flyers: #87 **sword**, #93 **world cup**, and #95 **stl**. And the last is #98 **music**.

### Next, ranked \#101-150

At #102 is Roundup regular **dice**, followed at #104 by **4th of july png**; it has 150%. Then at #113-118, there is a sextet: **world cup 2026**, **therian mask**, **dnd dice**, **resident evil**, **yumeship**, **dandys world**. And among them is our first unicorn of the month.

#### \#114 “therian mask” – May CTR: 147%

![Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “therian mask.” The line chart depicts its 15-mo search history.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image.png)Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “therian mask.” The line chart depicts its 15-mo search history.

At a glance, search volumes appear low, right? But that’s only because all other months are dwarfed by the mega spike it had last September. Searches soared to nearly 90,000.

Keep an eye out for “therian mask” on upcoming Roundups. Last month, it just missed the search-count threshold, but it had a CTR of 150%. And we know “therian mask” has made other Roundups.

We’ll be watching for it from now on, too. Its related-searches table indicates clear opportunity. Quite a few with high CTRs and low competition. Here for ideas of what to sell on Etsy in a niche you could make your own?

Resuming our Roundup, there’s a pair next: #135-136 **sonic birthday invitation** and **slime**. “Slime” has 150%! Skip one and there’s **keycaps**, also with 150% and by the way: Unicorn Alert! We featured “keycaps” in [January](https://help.erank.com/blog/top-keywords-on-etsy-january-2026/)‘s Roundup; it ranked 7th that month’s Top 20. A Roundup regular high flyer, it had 150% last month, too.

A half dozen more qualifiers in this set of 50: #139 **carfax**, #141 **phone charm**, and #145 **twitch overlay**. And then a trio: #148-150 **horse**, **garden decor**, and **svg files**.

### Finally, ranking \#151-200

At #156 we have **deltarune**, then a trio: #158-160 **pokmon** _\[sic\]_ **birthday invitation**, **fnaf**, and **graduation stole**. Another unicorn!

#### \#160 “graduation stole” – May CTR: 150%

![Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “graduation stole.” The line chart depicts its 15-mo search history. And it has eRank's "Trending in Search!" badge flagging that it is still one of the top keywords on Etsy now.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-5.png)Left, Etsy US keyword stats for “graduation stole.” The line chart depicts its 15-mo search history. And it has eRank’s “Trending in Search!” badge flagging that it is still one of the top keywords on Etsy now.

Easy to assume that “graduation stole” would be too seasonal to bother with, right? But no: nine out of 15 months, it’s had searches above 3,500/mo, including six with 7,500+/mo. And an exceptionally good Average CTR: 136%. That is sky high for a 12-mo CTR. And yet Competition is still way in the green: just over 8,000 US listings use this keyword.

So many ways to carve out your own niche here. How you make them, customize, personalize. Maybe offer finer quality materials, or a nice keepsake box to store it in. Conversely, you could just offer lightning-fast turnaround or free shipping.

We took a quick look at the related searches table. Quite a few searches include a specific country; some want to honor their heritage on graduation day. So, that’s another niche. For those of you here for ideas of what to sell on Etsy, we see real opportunity here.

#### Resuming our Roundup…

At #165-166 are **homestuck** and **last day of school png**. Then two high flyers, #168 **enamel pin** (150%!) and **custom plush**. The latter has an _average_ CTR of 140%! Next up is qualifier #173 **limbus company**, followed by five in a row with 150%! First the pair at #177-178 **bachelorette** and **disney**, then #180 **flower**, #182 **class of 2026**, and #185 **watercolor pet portraits**.

And we wind up this month with a quartet of qualifiers. Ranked #188-191: **unisex heavy blendtm hooded sweatshirt**, **minecraft**, **snoopy**, and **statement rings**. And that’s a wrap for this month, gang. Hope some of these prove to be profitable leads for you!

### As for us, we’re off to see what’s trending on Etsy UK

As always, we love hearing what you think. Got questions or suggestions? You’re welcome to join us in eRank’s private Facebook [group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/EtsyRank/). With over 29,000 members from around the world, someone friendly is always up and about. And don’t miss our weekly live Q&As on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/c/eRank), where you’ll also find dozens of eRank tutorials, demos and more! Like [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/tag/erank?lang=en)? We’ve got lots of fun how-tos there, and here we are on [Pinterest](https://uk.pinterest.com/erankseo/), [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/eRankCommunity/) and [Threads](https://www.threads.com/@erankseo).

RESOURCES: eRank’s [Trend Buzz](https://help.erank.com/features/trend-buzz/) and [Keyword Tool](https://help.erank.com/features/keyword-tool/) have 15 months of historical Etsy search data to help you understand trends in what’s selling on Etsy now, what did well this time last year, and to help you spot what’s new. Together, they are the best way to track what’s popular with Etsy shoppers now.

## Top Etsy Searches Trending in Q1 2026

# Top Etsy Searches Trending in Q1 2026

23 April 2026

•

10 min read

[![](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/facebook.png)](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://help.erank.com/blog/top-etsy-searches-q1-2026/)

[![](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/linkedin.png)](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https://help.erank.com/blog/top-etsy-searches-q1-2026/)

[![](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/reddit.png)](https://reddit.com/submit?url=https://help.erank.com/blog/top-etsy-searches-q1-2026/)

![eRank quarterly trend report for Etsy US, Q1 2026](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/top-etsy-us-search-terms-q1-2026.webp)

Want to see what this year’s top Etsy searches are so far? Let’s get that guesswork out of your SEO and product research. First, we’ll look at the Top 20 keywords in Q1 (January-March). Then we’ll find out what all Top 200 keywords say about what’s selling best on Etsy these days.

## Q1’s Top 20 keywords

01. tshirt
02. stickers
03. shirt
04. valentines day gift
05. pokemon
06. gift
07. jewelry
08. necklace
09. wall art
10. earrings
11. keychain
12. home decor
13. phone case
14. keycaps
15. ita bag
16. ring
17. crochet
18. sticker
19. womens clothing
20. heated rivalry

_Warning: Beware of trademarked terms. This report may contain keywords that are trademarked.  [USPTO Trademark Database](https://www.uspto.gov/trademarks-application-process/search-trademark-database)_

Wow: surprises! We always start our trend reports by comparing the current Top 20 searches with the previous list. It’s the quickest way to spot rising trends. For our Quarterly reports, we compare quarters Year on Year, i.e., Q1 2026 with Q1 2025. Even Year on Year, the same quarters have more in common: their season, their main gift-buying holiday. Of course, we expect more change than we see in our monthly trend reports.

Even so, this Q1 2026 Top 20 list got our data geek heart rates going! And it isn’t “climbers” (new keywords making this Q1 Top 20 that weren’t in last year’s). No, what caught our eye is what’s now in the Top 3 – and what’s not.

#### No. 1: “tshirt,” up from \#13 in Q1 2025

![On the left, Etsy Q1 2026 keyword stats for “tshirt.” Right, the line chart tracks its search volume over the past 15 months. Notably, "tshirt" has both gold badges: for high conversion, and for being among the top Etsy searches this week.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image.png)On the left, Etsy Q1 2026 keyword stats for “tshirt.” Right, the line chart tracks its search volume over the past 15 months. Notably, “tshirt” has both gold badges: for high conversion, and for being among the top Etsy searches this week.

#### No. 3: “shirt,” up from \#15 in Q1 2025

![Left, Etsy Q1 2026 keyword stats for “shirt.” The line chart tracks its search volume over the past 15 months. The gold "High Conversion" badge indicates lots of shoppers using this keyword in the past 30 days added to carts and purchased.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-1.png)Left, Etsy Q1 2026 keyword stats for “shirt.” The line chart tracks its search volume over the past 15 months. The gold “High Conversion” badge indicates lots of shoppers using this keyword in the past 30 days added to carts and purchased.

Sometimes, it is easier to spot a sea change in quarterly data. Q1 2024 had no shirt searches in its Top 20. In Q1 2025, none made its Top 10. This year, Q1 has two in the Top 3!

We had gotten so used to seeing “wall art” in that top spot, it came as a shock that it’s not.

#### Last year’s Q1 No. 1: “wall art,” now \#9

![Left, Etsy Q1 2026 keyword stats for “wall art.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. "Wall art" has both gold badges, for 30+ days of high conversion, and being among the top Etsy searches this week.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-2.png)Left, Etsy Q1 2026 keyword stats for “wall art.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. “Wall art” has both gold badges, for 30+ days of high conversion, and being among the top Etsy searches this week.

It is a relief to see both badges; shoppers are still flocking to Etsy for wall art. And buying! “Wall art” actually has a better Q1 click-through rate now than it had in Q1 2025. Isn’t that what matters most?

### Click-through rates and purchase intent

For those of you who are new to selling online, here’s a quick explainer.

> On ecommerce sites, click-through rates (CTRs) reflect how many times shoppers clicked listings in their search results. Therefore, CTRs are an indicator of ‘purchase intent.’ These are people more likely searching with the intention to buy, as opposed to those just browsing.

You’ll want to keep up with the latest Etsy trending searches, sure. But for insight into which are _selling_ best, look to their click-through rates. It’s why we end every trend report with a “CTR Roundup.” You’ll see which of the current top Etsy searches have had the highest CTRs most recently.

Before we get to Q1’s Roundup though, we’ll be taking a quick look at its climbers. So here’s a teaser: this quarter’s Top 20 search with the highest CTR.

#### \#18 sticker – Q1 CTR: 147%

![Left, Etsy Q1 2026 keyword stats for “sticker.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. "Sticker" has both gold badges, for 30+ days of high conversion, and it's also among the top Etsy searches this week.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-4.png)Left, Etsy Q1 2026 keyword stats for “sticker.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. “Sticker” has both gold badges, for 30+ days of high conversion, and it’s also among the top Etsy searches this week.

147% is a ton of purchase intent! And for a 12-mo average, that 127% CTR is pretty stunning, too.

### Q1 Top 20 searches new Year on Year

These are the keywords that weren’t in last year’s Q1 Top 20. They are in current rank order, their former rank listed last.

Ranked 4th: “valentines day gift,” up from #140 in Q1 2025

13th: “phone case,” up from #85

15th: “ita bag,” up from #136

16th: “ring,” up from #27 (but “rings” ranked 9th)

17th: “crochet,” up from #32

18th: “sticker,” up from #69

19th: “womens clothing,” up from #54

20th: “heated rivalry” (not in Q1 2025’s Top 1000)

Since its plural ranked 9th in Q1 2025, “ring” shouldn’t count as a climber. Conversely, “sticker” deserves double points. Last year’s Q1 Top 20 had just the one entry, #3 “stickers.” This year, “stickers” is in second place plus there’s #18 “sticker.”

In the US, Q1’s main gift-buying holiday is Valentine’s Day. While exact-search “valentines day gift” ranked #140 last year, four other Valentine-related searches made its Q1 Top 20. This year, we’re down to just the one. Could be more Etsy shoppers preferred clicking an Etsy “Valentine’s Day Gift” promo instead of typing searches. But last year’s Q1 breakout star #14 “galentine gift” does appear to have lost favor. This Q1, the highest “galentine” search ranks #126.

As for the rest of these climbers, “womens clothing” is more Category than keyword. And “heated rivalry” is protected intellectual property; enough said. Which leaves three and from 2023 on, none of these have made a Q1 Top 20 before.

#### Ranked 13th: “phone case,” up from \#85 in Q1 2025

![Left, keyword stats for “phone case.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. And "phone case" has both gold badges, for 30+ days of high conversion, and being among the top Etsy searches this week.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-8.png)Left, keyword stats for “phone case.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. And “phone case” has both gold badges, for 30+ days of high conversion, and being among the top Etsy searches this week.

Of course, phone cases have been making the occasional monthly Etsy Top 20 for years. The same is true of “crochet.” While this may be its Q1 Top 20 debut, “crochet” has made a number of monthly Top 20 lists.

#### Ranked 17th: “crochet,” up from \#32

![Left, keyword stats for “crochet.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. And "crochet" has both gold badges, "High Conversion" and "Trending in Search."](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-9.png)Left, keyword stats for “crochet.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. And “crochet” has both gold badges, “High Conversion” and “Trending in Search.”

This next one though has only just begun to make Top 20 lists in 2026. But it sure has been starring in lots of Monthly CTR Roundups!

#### Ranked 15th: “ita bag,” up from \#136

![Left, keyword stats for “ita bag.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. And it has the gold "High Conversion" badge. Lots of shoppers who used this keyword in the past 30 days added to carts and purchased.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-3.png)Left, keyword stats for “ita bag.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. And it has the gold “High Conversion” badge. Lots of shoppers who used this keyword in the past 30 days added to carts and purchased.

“Ita bag” is what we fondly call a unicorn (because Etsy naysayers claim they don’t exist). These unicorns are products with proven demand, search history, purchase intent, low competition. Just as you see here.

So, let’s go see if we can find some more, shall we?

## Roundup! Top Etsy keywords with 135%+ Q1 CTRs

Here for ideas of what to sell on Etsy? Then this is for you! Your insider access to which of Q1’s top Etsy searches show the most purchase intent.

Keep in mind, these calculations are drawn exclusively from this quarter’s data. Which means, whatever their 12-mo CTRs, most of these products should be what’s selling best now. As for any related to Valentine’s Day or Easter shopping, add them to a [Keyword List](https://help.erank.com/features/keyword-lists/). That way, you’ll be a step ahead on your SEO and product research for next year.

### Ranking \#1-50

Note: for readability, we’ll only shout out individual CTRs above 145%. But every keyword listed here will have at least 135%, which is wildly high. Which in turn means any that interest you are worth researching.

There are five qualifiers in Q1’s Top 20: #3 **shirt**, #13-15 **phone** **case**, **keycaps**, **ita** **bag**, and #18 **sticker**. Moving on to the rest of the Top 50, at #21 we have **valentine**. It’s followed by high flyer #32 **digital** with 150%, and #34 **digital products**. Up next: #38 **bookmark**, then Roundup regular #40 **fursuit**.

#### \#40 fursuit – Q1 CTR: 136%

![Left, keyword stats for “fursuit.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. "Fursuit" has both gold badges, "High Conversion" and "Trending in Search."](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/fursuit.png)Left, keyword stats for “fursuit.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. “Fursuit” has both gold badges, “High Conversion” and “Trending in Search.”

As we have been saying for awhile now, “fursuit” is a unicorn.

And the last three qualifiers in this set of 50 are #43-44 **candle** and **valentines** and #48 **jewelry box**.

### Ranked from \#51-100

Here, we open with four more Roundup regulars: #52 **dice** (146%), #60 **furry**, #63 **anime** (150%!), and #65 **vtuber model**. Next up, #67 **resident evil**, #76 **pins**, #80 **fivem**, #83 **riftbound**, then #85-86 **blue** (147%) and **home gifts**. Then at #94-97, a quartet: **calendar**, **cosplay**, **homestuck**, **hoodie**. And the final two are both high flyers: #99-100 **dnd dice** and **custom plush**.

### Next, ranked \#101-150

At #102 is **chiikawa**, followed by #105 **gachiakuta**. There’s a pair at #108-109: **disney** and **photocard** **holder**. Unicorn Alert!

#### \#109 photocard holder – Q1 CTR: 138%

![Left, keyword stats for “photocard holder.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. It also has eRank's gold "High Conversion" badge.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-10.png)Left, keyword stats for “photocard holder.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. It also has eRank’s gold “High Conversion” badge.

Right now, “photocard holder” qualifies as a unicorn on Etsy US, UK, and Canada. Check them out: super cute! They’re popular for displaying the K-pop photocards that fans collect. Or to dangle from backpacks, bags, keychains amid all things Y2K and K-pop. Both are massive and global trends.

In fact, we’re surprised Etsy listing competition for “photocard holder” is still this accessible. Anyone looking for what to sell on Etsy in an upbeat, low-barrier niche you could make your own? This one looks promising.

Moving on, at #122-123 we have **bag** and **limbus company**. Skip one and there’s Roundup frequent flyer **pngtuber**. Then we have a ways to go before the next, a trio: #145-147 **tumbler**, **dog** and **valentine shirt**. The latter two have 147% Q1 CTRs.

### Ranked from \#151-200

Right off, another high flyer.

#### \#154 purple – Q1 CTR: 150%

![Left, keyword stats for “purple.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. "Purple" has both gold badges, "High Conversion" and "Trending in Search."](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-6.png)Left, keyword stats for “purple.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. “Purple” has both gold badges, “High Conversion” and “Trending in Search.”

We aren’t sure why, but single-word color names make every Etsy Roundup. (Not Amazon’s, not eBay’s: just Etsy’s.) And just feast your eyes on that 12-mo Avg. CTR: 146%! That is phenomenally high. As for what particular purple product it is that shoppers want, you can try this time-honored trick.

![Etsy homepage search bar with its dropdown menu of suggestions related to purple.](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-11.png)Etsy homepage search bar with its dropdown menu of suggestions related to purple.

Better yet, scroll down purple’s page in Keyword Tool to its related searches table. “Purple rug” and “purple curtains” both got 1,000+ searches in March.

And right after “purple” on our Roundup, the next two qualifiers are also colors. And high flyers! These are #165 **gold** and #167 **black**; both have 150% CTRs for Q1.

After those we have two pairs: #184-185 **silver** and **kirby**, then #191-192 **christmas** and **elden ring**. “Christmas” has 150%! Ardent post-holiday bargain hunters?

#### \#191 christmas  – Q1 CTR: 150%

![Left, keyword stats for “christmas.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. "Christmas" has both gold badges, "High Conversion" and "Trending in Search."](https://d3p0ctlqg0dpqn.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-7.png)Left, keyword stats for “christmas.” The line chart tracks its 15-mo search volume. “Christmas” has both gold badges, “High Conversion” and “Trending in Search.”

Whoa! Looks like it. “Christmas” has both badges – _in mid-April!_

web.markdown:
![Thumbnail (1920x1080)](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/l3-BYTx2zR0/maxresdefault.jpg)
# [Etsy SEO: Why Simple Titles Win in 2026](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l3-BYTx2zR0)

**Visibility**: Public
**Uploaded by**: [eRank](https://www.youtube.com/@eRank)
**Uploaded at**: 2026-06-10
**Published at**: 
**Length**: 05:41
**Views**: 1581
**Likes**: 118
**Category**: Education

## Description

```
Stop keyword stuffing your Etsy SEO. Learn how to write clear, descriptive Etsy titles that improve search visibility and sales.
🔽 Expand for more tips! 🔽

🤔 Want to ask the eRank team questions? 
Join the official Facebook group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/EtsyRank

🧡 Ready to improve your Etsy SEO and growth?
Sign up for a FREE eRank account today: https://erank.com/

✍️ Grab more eRank resources: https://s.mtrbio.com/erank

Check out these YouTube channels for more Etsy tips and tricks:
🐺 Follow Starla: https://www.youtube.com/@StarlaMoore
💜 Follow Pam: https://www.youtube.com/@PamDuthie
🖤 Follow Bryan: https://www.youtube.com/@BryanSupport

#eRank #EtsySEO #handmadebusinesses
```

## Transcript

Most Etsy sellers write their titles backwards. They start by asking,
"What keywords can I fit into my title or how many keywords can I fit in there?"
And I understand why. But today, I want to show you a simple change in thinking
that'll make writing Etsy titles so much easier. And we'll use real examples. We'll look at
Etsy's latest advice on titles on how to choose stronger keywords. And while we're doing this,
I even found a unicorn keyword hiding in a very competitive niche. Let's dig in.
For years, Etsy sellers have been told that keywords are important. So, naturally,
we start collecting as many as we can and try and squeeze them into our titles. But Etsy's own
advice suggests we should actually start somewhere else. Let me show you what I mean. Imagine you're
scrolling through Etsy and you see this title. Gift for her, birthday gift, gift for mom,
personalized gift. What is it? Is it a necklace, a mug? A candle, a t-shirt? I have no idea. Now,
compare that to this title. Personalized Hebrew name necklace. Instantly, you know
what you're looking at. And that's exactly what Etsy says it wants. In the Etsy seller handbook,
they recommend writing short, clear, descriptive titles and leading with the words that describe
your item best. In other words, before a shopper can decide whether they want your item,
they first need to understand what it is. And Etsy needs to understand that, too.
Now, it doesn't mean keywords are dead. Far from it. The best Etsy titles still are built
around keywords. The difference is that not all keywords are equally useful. So, let's go back
to our necklace example. If you sell personalized necklaces, you could target necklace, but that's
a really broad keyword. Or you could target name necklace. That's better. Or Hebrew name necklace.
Now, we're getting much more specific. Not only does that describe the product more clearly, but
it also tells us something about the shopper. This is where keyword research becomes really powerful.
Good keyword research isn't just about finding the words to place in your title. It's about
understanding how buyers think and what they're searching for. How do they describe products like
yours? What styles and interests are they looking for? That's one of the reasons exists. So instead
of guessing what shoppers might search for, you can use E-Rank's keyword tool to see how popular a
keyword really is and how much competition you're up against. If we look at our examples, necklace
has that expected huge search volume, but the competition is also wild. Name necklace is more
specific, but still very, very high competition. And [snorts] then we get to Hebrew name necklace.
That's what we call a unicorn keyword. It has healthy searches. People are clicking on it
and the competition is much more manageable. And by targeting Hebrew name necklace, you're not
abandoning name necklace or even necklace. You're still clearly describing a type of name necklace
and a type of necklace. What you've done is move from a broad audience to a very specific audience.
At E-rank, we often say that the successful keywords sit at that intersection between
demand and opportunity. There may be more shoppers searching for necklace, but there are also far
more sellers competing for those views. By niching down, you're not reducing your opportunity. You're
increasing your chance to be seen by the shoppers who are most likely to be interested in your
product. Don't try and be relevant to everyone. Be highly relevant to someone. But once you've
found these keywords, don't make the mistake of stuffing every single keyword into your title.
Start with that phrase that best describes your item. Personalized Hebrew name necklace.
Then add supporting details that help shoppers understand it. Silver Jewish jewelry gift. Because
at the end of the day, the best Etsy title does two things. They help buyers understand exactly
what you're selling, and they help Etsy understand exactly what you're selling. This helps Etsy show
your item to the right shopper and it helps the shopper realize your item is just what they want
when they see it in search. So before you write your next title, ask yourself one simple question.
If someone only reads the first few words, would they immediately know what I'm selling?
If the answer is yes, you're probably on the right track. Now, one final thing before you go. Writing
a better title is not the finish line on Etsy. It's just the start. Once your title is live,
pay attention to how shoppers respond. Are you getting more views, more clicks, more favorites,
more sales? Every listing is an experiment, and every result teaches you something about your
niche, your products, and your shoppers. Your goal isn't to write the perfect title the first time.
It's to keep learning and make your next title a little better than the last one. If you like this
video, don't forget to subscribe. My next video will cover the mistakes [music] Etsy sellers make.
[music]

The most searched keywords on Etsy in 2026 span six main categories. **Jewelry & accessories** lead with terms like “gold necklace layered,” “personalized jewelry,” and “birthstone ring.” **Home decor** drives massive volume with “boho wall art,” “custom family name sign,” and “aesthetic room decor.”

**Digital downloads** are rising fast — “printable planner 2026,” “digital sticker pack,” and “Canva template” see consistent high volume. **Apparel & gifts** trends include “custom sweatshirt,” “funny graphic tee,” and “personalized gift for her.”

**Seasonal search spikes** around Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, and Christmas create temporary surges of 300–800% for gift-related terms. Use a keyword research tool to find exact volumes for your specific niche.

## Etsy Keyword Research: Dos and Don'ts

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

### ❌Don't Do This

- •**Repeat the same keyword multiple times in your tags** — Etsy treats repeats as one tag, wasting slots
- •**Keyword-stuff your title until it reads like nonsense** — readability affects click-through rate
- •**Ignore long-tail keywords** — they convert better even with lower search volume
- •**Assume last year's top keywords are still top keywords in 2026** — trends shift constantly
- •**Copy competitor keywords blindly** — check whether you can actually compete before targeting them

### ✅Do This Instead

- •**Use all 13 tag slots on every listing** — each unused tag slot is a missed ranking opportunity
- •**Include the keyword in your listing title** — ideally near the beginning for maximum weight
- •**Use buyer language, not maker language** — "gold necklace for women" not "handcrafted 14k fill chain"
- •**Research seasonal spikes 6–8 weeks ahead** — Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Christmas
- •**Update your tags when you notice a keyword losing traction** — stale tags hurt rankings

## Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to the most common questions about Etsy keyword research.

What are the most searched keywords on Etsy right now in 2026?

Based on aggregated Etsy search data, the consistently most searched keyword categories in 2026 include: personalized jewelry (e.g., "custom name necklace," "birthstone bracelet"), home decor wall art (e.g., "boho wall art," "minimalist prints"), digital downloads (e.g., "printable planner 2026," "digital sticker pack"), and custom gifts (e.g., "personalized gift for her," "custom sweatshirt"). Exact rankings shift monthly — use a dedicated Etsy keyword tool for live data.

How often do top Etsy search keywords change?

The core category keywords (jewelry, home decor, apparel) remain stable for 6–12 months. However, trending and seasonal terms can spike and drop within weeks. Valentine's Day keywords surge 400–800% in late January through early February, then collapse. Monitor your keyword data monthly and refresh tags on seasonal products 6–8 weeks before peak search periods.

Does using trending keywords actually improve Etsy sales?

Yes, when done correctly. Ranking for a keyword with high search volume and moderate competition is one of the fastest ways to increase organic Etsy traffic. Sellers who regularly optimize their keywords using data-driven tools report 20–40% more impressions within 30 days of updating titles and tags. The key is combining volume (people are searching) with competition (you can rank) and relevance (it matches your product).

What's the difference between a keyword and a tag on Etsy?

They work together but serve different functions. Keywords are the phrases buyers type into Etsy search. Tags are what you add to your listings (up to 13) to tell Etsy's algorithm what your item is about. Etsy's search algorithm matches buyer keywords to listing tags, titles, and descriptions. To rank for a keyword, that exact phrase (or a close match) should appear in your tags.

Are long-tail keywords better than broad keywords on Etsy?

Long-tail keywords (4+ word phrases like "personalized birthstone necklace for mom") typically convert better than broad keywords ("necklace") even though they have lower search volume. Broad keywords have massive competition — thousands of listings compete for "necklace." Long-tail phrases attract buyers who know exactly what they want, leading to higher conversion rates and better Etsy search ranking for new shops.

How do I find keywords competitors are ranking for on Etsy?

You can manually check competitor listing titles and tags by clicking "See all 13 tags" on any Etsy listing. For systematic competitor keyword research, use a shop analysis tool like Insight Agent that shows you exactly which keywords drive traffic to any Etsy shop — without the manual guesswork.

What keywords should I avoid on Etsy?

Avoid branded terms (Disney, Harry Potter, etc.) unless you have a license — listings with copyright-infringing tags get removed. Also avoid irrelevant keywords added just to capture traffic (Etsy's algorithm penalizes this). Don't use the same keyword in multiple tags — Etsy counts them as one. And avoid overly broad single-word tags like "gift" or "art" — too competitive to rank for, too vague to convert.
